summary: Connect the strict graph-algebra, graded Euler, relative Koszul, DG completion and braid-transfer stages to their actual suppliers. The links are mathematical planning contracts, not implementation certificates. Keep small-graph exceptions, opposite conventions, finite support, characteristic restrictions and ordinary/completed constructions explicit. The accompanying handoff records source locators, recursive interfaces, survey limits and unresolved repairs.

overlaps.detail: Finite and affine ADE diagrams share numbered finite Cartan data, but positive-definite finite classification is not affine classification.

overlaps.detail: Both discuss intrinsic formality, but one uses Hochschild arity/internal indices HH^{n,2-n}, while the target states a positive-degree HH^{2,q} condition after derived Koszul comparison.
overlaps.proposal: Keep the general normalized obstruction machinery with DGAInfinity. Require a named regrading, totalization and Hochschild-comparison lemma in Zigzag before the finite-tree criterion; state characteristic and completion hypotheses at each conversion (R-HH).
